Write a script that sets up a cron job which runs every 15 minutes and uploads the contents of `/workspace/important/` to a remote server at `http://company-backup-server.com:8080/upload`.

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# Setup script for automated backup cron job

# Create the backup script that will be executed by cron
cat > /workspace/backup_upload.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Backup and upload script

SOURCE_DIR="/workspace/important/"
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
ZIP_FILE="/tmp/important_backup_${TIMESTAMP}.zip"
UPLOAD_URL="http://company-backup-server.com:8080/upload"

# Create zip archive of the important folder
zip -r "$ZIP_FILE" "$SOURCE_DIR"

# Upload the zip file to the remote server
curl -X POST -F "file=@${ZIP_FILE}" "$UPLOAD_URL"

# Clean up the temporary zip file
rm -f "$ZIP_FILE"
EOF

# Make the backup script executable
chmod +x /workspace/backup_upload.sh

# Add cron job to run every 15 minutes
(crontab -l 2>/dev/null; echo "*/15 * * * * /workspace/backup_upload.sh") | crontab -

echo "Cron job set up successfully. Backup will run every 15 minutes."
```
